project.title: Dinoyo Kamera - Integrated Business Information System
project.description: Sistem informasi terintegrasi untuk seluruh proses bisnis Dinoyo Kamera, dari inventory hingga quality control.
project.longDescription: Sistem informasi bisnis terintegrasi yang mencakup seluruh proses operasional Dinoyo Camera. Sistem ini mengelola inventory, pembelian (purchase), penjualan, quality control, dan pelaporan. Dirancang untuk meningkatkan efisiensi dan akurasi data bisnis.
project.challenge: Proses bisnis Dinoyo Kamera masih terpisah-pisah antara inventory, pembelian, penjualan, dan quality control. Data tidak terintegrasi menyebabkan duplikasi dan kesalahan input.
project.solution: Membangun sistem informasi terintegrasi yang menghubungkan seluruh proses bisnis dalam satu platform. Data mengalir otomatis antar modul, mengurangi kesalahan input dan meningkatkan efisiensi.
project.goal: Mengintegrasikan seluruh proses bisnis Dinoyo Kamera untuk meningkatkan efisiensi dan akurasi data.
project.outcome: Data bisnis lebih akurat, proses lebih cepat, dan pengambilan keputusan lebih mudah.

project.title: Guess The Song - Music Quiz Game
project.description: Interactive music quiz game where players guess song titles from 7-second audio previews. Built with Next.js and iTunes API.
project.longDescription: Guess The Song is a fun, interactive web game that tests your music knowledge. Players choose their favorite artist, listen to a 7-second audio preview from the middle of a random song, and guess the correct title from three multiple-choice options. The game features a scoring system, progress tracking, and supports 10 rounds per session with stats calculation at the end.
project.challenge: The main challenge was working with the iTunes API which only provides 30-second previews starting from the beginning of songs. The goal was to create a fair 'middle of the song' experience without access to the full track or custom preview points. Additionally, handling HTTP preview URLs on HTTPS websites and ensuring smooth audio playback across different browsers required careful implementation.
project.solution: I implemented a custom audio player with timeline control that attempts to start playback from the 10-second mark. A fallback mechanism automatically plays from the beginning if seeking fails due to CORS restrictions. The iTunes API is proxied through Next.js rewrites to solve HTTPS mixed-content issues. The game also features a debounced search for artists, glassmorphic UI design, and real-time progress tracking to enhance user experience.
project.goal: To build a fun, accessible music quiz game that anyone can play without requiring Spotify or Apple Music subscriptions. The goal was to create an engaging experience that tests music knowledge while maintaining a clean, modern UI.
project.outcome: A fully functional web game that allows users to test their music knowledge across various artists. The game features smooth audio playback, intuitive UI, and comprehensive game statistics. It's deployed and accessible to anyone with an internet connection.

project.title: YBLP Digital Beneficiary & Program Management System
project.description: Sistem pendataan digital untuk manajemen data penerima manfaat dan program sosial yayasan secara terpusat.
project.longDescription: Sistem ini dikembangkan untuk mendigitalisasi proses pendataan di Yayasan Bumi Langgat Peduli, mencakup master data Anak Yatim dan Duafa, pengelolaan sesi program (Santunan, Khitan Masal, Bedah Rumah), manajemen peserta per program, dashboard ringkasan, serta laporan dan ekspor data. Sistem dibangun berbasis Google Apps Script + Google Sheets dengan antarmuka web admin yang responsif.
project.challenge: Proses pendataan sebelumnya rawan duplikasi data, sulit dipantau lintas program, dan tidak efisien saat membuat laporan berkala.
project.solution: Membangun sistem admin terintegrasi dengan autentikasi sesi, struktur data terstandar per program, validasi input, pencegahan duplikasi peserta, serta fitur laporan dan ekspor untuk operasional harian yayasan.
project.goal: Membangun sistem pendataan yayasan yang rapi, cepat, dan minim error untuk mendukung pengambilan keputusan program sosial.
project.outcome: Sistem membantu admin mengelola data penerima dan program secara lebih efisien, mengurangi duplikasi, serta mempercepat pembuatan laporan operasional.

project.title: Dinoyo Kamera - Catalog & Profile Website
project.description: Website katalog dan profile toko kamera yang memudahkan customer melihat dan mencari produk secara realtime.
project.longDescription: Sebuah website e-commerce katalog untuk Dinoyo Kamera, toko kamera di Malang. Website ini memungkinkan customer untuk melihat dan mencari produk kamera beserta aksesorisnya dengan status ketersediaan realtime. Setiap produk dilengkapi dengan aksi langsung yang mengarahkan customer ke WhatsApp admin untuk proses pembelian.
project.challenge: Toko kamera Dinoyo Kamera mengalami kesulitan dalam menampilkan katalog produk secara digital dan realtime. Customer sering bertanya tentang ketersediaan stok produk, yang memakan waktu admin.
project.solution: Membangun website katalog dengan sistem manajemen produk yang update stok secara realtime. Customer bisa langsung melihat ketersediaan produk dan terhubung ke WhatsApp admin untuk pembelian.
project.goal: Mendigitalisasi katalog produk Dinoyo Kamera agar customer mudah melihat produk dan stok secara realtime.
project.outcome: Customer dapat melihat ketersediaan produk tanpa perlu bertanya admin, meningkatkan efisiensi penjualan.

project.title: Setiap Suara Perempuan Harus Didengar
project.description: Website kampanye sosial untuk mendukung dan melindungi suara perempuan korban kekerasan.
project.longDescription: Website statis yang dibuat untuk program Perempuan Inovasi 2025 dari Markoding. Website ini bertujuan untuk menyuarakan dukungan terhadap perempuan korban kekerasan, menyediakan informasi, dan menciptakan ruang aman bagi mereka. Dibangun dengan vanilla HTML, CSS, dan JavaScript murni.
project.challenge: Masih banyak perempuan korban kekerasan yang tidak memiliki akses ke informasi dan dukungan. Perlu platform yang aman dan informatif untuk menyuarakan isu ini.
project.solution: Membangun website kampanye sosial yang informatif dan empatik dengan desain yang menenangkan, menyediakan informasi tentang dukungan yang tersedia.
project.goal: Menyuarakan dukungan terhadap perempuan korban kekerasan dan menyediakan informasi bantuan.
project.outcome: Meningkatkan kesadaran tentang isu kekerasan terhadap perempuan dan ketersediaan dukungan.

project.title: Ar-Rahman Mosque Visitor Management System
project.description: Sistem manajemen pengunjung masjid real-time dengan integrasi smart LED board untuk Masjid Ar-Rahman Kitakyushu, Jepang.
project.longDescription: Sistem manajemen pengunjung real-time yang dikembangkan untuk program pengabdian masyarakat internasional di Masjid Ar-Rahman Kitakyushu, Jepang. Sistem ini terdiri dari web application untuk visitor registration dan admin dashboard, serta smart LED board berbasis ESP32 yang menampilkan informasi real-time.
project.challenge: Masjid Ar-Rahman membutuhkan sistem untuk memantau jumlah pengunjung secara real-time dan memberikan informasi waktu sholat serta event masjid secara digital.
project.solution: Membangun sistem terintegrasi antara web application untuk visitor registration dan admin dashboard, serta smart LED board yang menampilkan informasi real-time dari ESP32.
project.goal: Membangun sistem manajemen pengunjung yang modern untuk Masjid Ar-Rahman di Jepang sebagai proyek pengabdian internasional.
project.outcome: Sistem berhasil diimplementasikan dan membantu pengurus masjid memantau pengunjung serta memberikan informasi digital.

project.title: School Supervision Assessment Tool
project.description: Google Apps Script web app untuk membantu pengawas sekolah memantau upload bukti penilaian dari sekolah binaan.
project.longDescription: Web application berbasis Google Apps Script yang membantu pengawas sekolah dalam memantau upload bukti persyaratan penilaian dari sekolah-sekolah binaan. Awalnya konsep dibuat menggunakan Gemini AI, kemudian saya realisasikan menjadi aplikasi fungsional yang dapat digunakan.
project.challenge: Pengawas sekolah kesulitan memantau upload bukti penilaian dari berbagai sekolah binaan secara manual melalui email dan chat.
project.solution: Membangun aplikasi berbasis Google Apps Script yang terintegrasi dengan Google Sheets, memungkinkan sekolah upload bukti dan pengawas memantau secara real-time.
project.goal: Membantu pengawas sekolah dalam memantau upload bukti penilaian dari sekolah binaan secara efisien.
project.outcome: Pengawas sekolah dapat memantau progress upload bukti penilaian secara real-time tanpa manual checking.

project.title: PiketAgain! — Classroom Cleaning & Ethics Game
project.description: A classroom-cleaning game that brings ethical choices into everyday school responsibilities, developed by a three-person team for a Game Development course.
project.longDescription: PiketAgain! combines classroom-cleaning activities with an emphasis on ethics and responsibility. Players interact with the classroom environment, complete quests, and follow their cleaning progress while responding to situations involving other characters. As team leader, I developed the original concept, designed the game systems, and contributed to implementation alongside two other developers. The team shared implementation work across the game's systems.
project.challenge: The design challenge was to connect cleaning tasks with ethical situations while keeping objectives and interactions understandable to players.
project.solution: The implementation combines interactable classroom objects, quest and progress tracking, NPC dialogue, a timer, and badge systems to support the cleaning-and-ethics concept.
project.goal: Encourage players to reflect on responsibility and ethical conduct through an interactive classroom-cleaning game.
project.outcome: Developed as a three-person Game Development course project. A public playable build is not linked yet.

project.title: Village Profile Website — KKN Community Project
project.description: A village information website and content-management system developed by a seven-person KKN team to organize village profiles, public information, and local potential.
project.longDescription: Developed as part of a KKN community-service project, this website brings together village identity, organizational information, news, agendas, tourism, UMKM, public documents, and service information. An administrative interface supports content management. I led the seven-person team and worked as a full stack developer. The project was developed but was not adopted by the village; it is presented here as a development project rather than an operational village service.
project.challenge: The information-design challenge was to organize a broad range of village content while giving administrators a practical way to maintain it.
project.solution: A Laravel application separates public information pages from authenticated administration, with content modules for village information, news, agendas, local potential, documents, and services.
project.goal: Provide a central place for village information and showcase local tourism and small businesses.
project.outcome: Developed during KKN by a seven-person team. The village did not adopt the website, and no public demo is currently linked.

project.title: TK ABA 8 Kepanjen — School Profile Website
project.description: A school profile website with an administrative workspace for managing school information, teachers, programs, news, achievements, and registration content.
project.longDescription: A freelance website for TK ABA 8 Kepanjen, developed independently across the full stack. The public website presents school information, programs, teachers, curriculum, news, achievements, and contact details, alongside a registration flow. Administrative pages allow school content to be maintained through a dedicated interface. The application uses Next.js and React, with Prisma and MySQL for structured content management.
project.challenge: The implementation challenge was to present a range of school information clearly while allowing content to be updated through an administrative interface.
project.solution: The application combines public school-information pages with authenticated content-management modules backed by Prisma and MySQL.
project.goal: Help families explore the school and provide a practical way to maintain its website content.
project.outcome: Independently developed the school website and administrative application for TK ABA 8 Kepanjen.

project.title: SIBAS — Waste Bank Management System
project.description: A waste-bank management application covering members, waste deposits, savings, inventory, cooperative purchases, and reporting, with separate member and admin workflows.
project.longDescription: SIBAS is a freelance waste-bank management application that I developed independently. Member-facing pages provide access to deposit history, purchase history, savings, notifications, and reports. Administrative modules handle members, waste categories and deposits, savings, inventory, cooperative sales, and reporting. Laravel powers the application, with PDF and spreadsheet libraries supporting report exports.
project.challenge: The workflow-design challenge was to connect waste deposits, member savings, inventory, and cooperative transactions while keeping member and administrative responsibilities separate.
project.solution: The Laravel application organizes operations into member and admin areas, with dedicated modules for deposits, savings, inventory, checkout, and PDF or spreadsheet report exports.
project.goal: Support organized waste-bank operations and give members access to their transaction and savings information.
project.outcome: Independently developed the waste-bank management application and its member and administrative workflows.

project.title: SiPuKa - Sistem Informasi Pusat Kamera
project.description: Sistem informasi toko kamera yang menghubungkan katalog publik dengan pengelolaan produk, pembelian, penjualan, dan quality control.
project.longDescription: SiPuKa menggabungkan website publik Pusat Kamera dengan pengelolaan operasional toko. Pengunjung dapat menjelajahi katalog, informasi toko, testimoni, dan halaman jual kamera. Area administrasi menyediakan pengelolaan produk dan foto, kategori, pelanggan, cabang, pembelian, penjualan, dan quality control, serta ekspor laporan PDF dan Excel.
project.challenge: Menghubungkan informasi produk untuk pengunjung dengan alur pembelian, penjualan, dan pemeriksaan kualitas toko kamera.
project.solution: Aplikasi Laravel dengan katalog publik, area administrasi terautentikasi, modul operasional, dan pengaturan akses berbasis peran.
project.goal: Memusatkan katalog kamera serta pengelolaan produk dan transaksi toko.
project.outcome: Website Pusat Kamera tersedia melalui pusatkamera.id, dengan katalog publik dan modul administrasi operasional.
